changelog:
🪟 Kiro accounts can now sign in with Microsoft (Entra ID), with Kiro profiles discovered across regions.
🔗 Follow-up requests stay on the account that served the conversation. Turn this off in settings to go back to round-robin.
🤖 Default model mappings now point to Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Opus 5.
🔎 Hosted web search results now appear in the reply instead of reaching the client as tool calls.
🔑 The generated admin password is now 8 digits. An unused 48-character password from an older version is replaced once.
🛡️ Admin password guesses are limited per client, and a distributed attack slows guessing without locking out the real admin.
📦 Request bodies are capped at 32 MiB after decompression, and at most eight compressed bodies are decompressed at once.
💾 Backup restore is now atomic and keeps an active ADMIN_PASSWORD override.
